children.value: > Fact From Story: Quantum dots can be injected into the body and attached to cells from the body’s immune system.
> > Fact From Story: By tagging the cells with fluorescent quantum dots, surgeons can spot even hard-to-see tumors inside the body.

> > > Fact From Story: The florescent quality of the particles allows researchers to track how drugs are delivered within the human body, as well as to study the precise location and growth of a tumor, for example.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: Scientists and surgeons are both researchers.
> > Fact From Story: Such cells swarm cancerous tissues.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Cancerous tumors are located inside the body.
> Commonsense Knowledge: Immune cells can swarm cancerous tissues.
